subject: Urgent: VantageRetail post-upgrade throughput collapse & error spike
messages:
From: Alicia Torres <alicia@vantageretail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: VantageRetail DevOps <devops@vantageretail.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Performance incident after today's model update

Hi Logan,

We started a scheduled upgrade to the v5.1 model with the new QProfile (qv3-int8) at 07:45 PT this morning. Within ~20 minutes we saw the API p95/p99 jump and a steady stream of 500 errors for our high-throughput reorder endpoint. Throughput collapsed from ~700 req/s to ~120 req/s; error rate climbed to ~6% and our consumers are timing out.

I've attached the logs and a Grafana snapshot. DevOps has already throttled traffic and enabled the fallback route to the previous model, which helped but the fallback is slower for some paths. Can you please confirm whether this was an expected change in the QProfile or model binary? This is customer-impacting; we need either an immediate rollback or a mitigation plan within the hour.

Alicia
Director, Platform Engineering
Vantage Retail

Attachments: vantage_logs_0718.zip, grafana_p99_snapshot.png

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia@vantageretail.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Performance incident after today's model update

Alicia — thanks for the heads up and the artifacts. I'm escalating immediately. Short plan:

3) I'll arrange a breakout call in 15 minutes to align on rollback cadence and customer comms.

Marissa — please prepare a short status update for the Vantage execs and confirm whether they want credits or an SLA exemption if rollback is required.

— Logan

Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia@vantageretail.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-18T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Performance incident after today's model update

TL;DR: initial signal points at qv3-int8 QProfile changes to KV cache packing and attention reorder; these increase decode latency for long-context hotpaths and expose a timeout window in our serving runtime.

Notes from quick analysis of the attached logs + runtime traces:
- Error signature: repeated 5xx from runtime decode stage; stack points to KV cache lookups failing under backpressure, then worker thread timeouts.
- Latency: median token time up ~2.2x on the affected routes; p99 > 3x.
- Canary: canary hosts entered degraded state ~6 minutes post rollout, correlating with increased request concurrency.

Immediate remediation options (ordered by speed/risk):
A) Roll back the QProfile to qv2-stable across the cluster (fast, requires config flip).
B) Reduce concurrency on canary and enable stricter KV cache eviction thresholds (medium).
C) Apply a runtime patch that changes KV lookup fallback behavior (requires build; ETA 3-4 hours).

I recommend option A for customer-facing recovery while we validate C in parallel. If we do A, we should also run a short warmup to rebuild caches before reopening full traffic.

I attached a small error_sample_5xx.json with representative traces. I'll keep digging and post a short postmortem once we stabilize.

— Rishi
Principal SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: error_sample_5xx.json
